The '''1930 Dutch East Indies census''' ({{langx|nl|Volkstelling 1930}}) was the last [[census]] of the [[Dutch East Indies]]. The total population was enumerated to be 60,727,233. Its population density in 1930 was {{Pop density|60727233|1904569|km2|prec=1|disp=num}} inhabitants/km<sup>2</sup>. {{sfn|Nitisastro|2006|p=75}}
